name: Grand Palladium Jamaica Resort Spa All Inclusive
description:
What makes us outstanding?
The hotel provides modern facilities and services, including international à la carte restaurants, pools, a spa and a wide range of daytime and evening leisure activities. Enjoy your stay with Infinite Indulgence®. Everything is included.

Prime location
Montego Bay on the northwest coast of Jamaica is famous for its white-sand beaches and the turquoise waters of the Caribbean Sea. A heavenly location surrounded by fascinating flora and fauna, picturesque towns and villages, golf courses and other natural treasures just 32km from the international airport.

Exceptional cuisine
3 international restaurants and 7 à la carte restaurants serving the finest Mexican, Indian, Japanese, Italian, Mediterranean, Steakhouse and, obviously, Jamaican cuisine. Guests can also choose from 17 bars with different styles and atmospheres, one of them open 24 hours a day.

Exclusive rooms
537 rooms with hydromassage bathtubs in 14 villas, also providing a pillow menu and aromatherapy services. The rooms have an exceptional design that combines all the modern comforts you need with a colonial style. Revel in luxurious holidays with heavenly views and premium options such as a private pool or exclusive villa just a few steps from the sea.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION FOR OUR VALUED GUESTS – GUEST ACCOMMODATION ROOM TAX (GART)
At Palladium Hotel Group, we are committed to enhancing the travel experience for all our guests while supporting the sustainable development of Jamaica’s tourism industry. In alignment with this mission, we would like to inform you about an important government mandated regulation that will apply at Grand Palladium Jamaica Resort & Spa – Grand Palladium Lady Hamilton. Guest Accommodation Room Tax (GART)* The Government of Jamaica requires all registered accommodations to collect the Guest Accommodation Room Tax (GART). The tax rate is US$4 per booking per night, and it will appear as a separate line item on guests’ final invoices. * Jamaica Information Service – GART Implementation in Grand Palladium Jamaica Resort & Spa Starting August 1, 2025, this tax will be applied to all reservations at Grand Palladium Lady Hamilton Resort & Spa, The Signature Level at Grand Palladium Lady Hamilton Resort & Spa, and Grand Palladium Jamaica Resort & Spa.” Purpose of the tax: Your contribution through this tax will: · Help improve and maintain tourism infrastructure and public services across the island. · Support environmental protection and conservation efforts that preserve Jamaica’s natural beauty. · Promote cultural activities and community programs that enrich your travel experience. · Foster sustainable tourism that benefits both guests and local communities. We thank you for your understanding and cooperation. By staying with us, you’re not only enjoying a memorable Caribbean escape—you’re also helping Jamaica continue to thrive as one of the world’s most cherished destinations.

name: Riu Palace Aquarelle - All Inclusive
description:
The Hotel Riu Palace Aquarelle, located on the seafront at White Bay Beach in the historic town of Falmouth, offers our excellent 24-hour All-Inclusive* service so you can enjoy a carefree, unforgettable holiday by the sea in the company of your family, partner or good friends.
The more than 700 rooms at this All-Inclusive hotel on White Bay Beach have all the amenities you need for a comfortable, restful and relaxing stay. If you want to cool off, the hotel’s 4 outdoor pools are the ideal way to enjoy the island's warm and sunny climate. What’s more, this 5-star hotel in Falmouth also has a children's pool for the youngest members of the family, as well as the Splash Water World water park where the whole family can have a blast. What's more, the hotel has a relaxing Wellness Centre where you can book massages, beauty treatments and hairdressing services or use our fully equipped gym that also offers exercise classes to help you stay in shape.
As for food, the different options available at the Hotel Riu Palace Aquarelle are a sure-fire hit. The best buffet breakfasts with live cooking stations await in the main restaurant, as well as exquisite lunches and dinners. In the evening, the Krystal restaurant offers exquisite à la carte fusion cuisine so you can try new flavours and enjoy an excellent, unforgettable evening. If you fancy a change, you can visit the Italian restaurant, the asian restaurant or the Steakhouse, where the chefs prepare delicious and innovative recipes that will delight your taste buds night after night. Finally, the Jerk Grill restaurant offers a varied buffet of grilled meat and vegetables.
What’s more, this is the best hotel in Falmouth if you’re looking for a bit of adventure as, thanks to its privileged beachfront location, you can play volleyball or try out some water sports such as snorkelling, diving, paddle surfing, kayaking or catamaran sailing. If you like golf, you can enjoy the wonderful golf course located near the hotel.
Lastly, if you want to make the most of your holiday in Jamaica to do some sightseeing, we recommend excursions to the north of the island, the incredible SumFest reggae parties in Montego Bay, Glistening Waters Bay where plankton light up under the water at night, or the Cockpit Country area, which is known as the “Jamaican Alps”. For more information, please take a look at the Falmouth destination guide to plan your perfect holiday on the island. Discover Jamaica with RIU!

name: Riu Montego Bay - Adults Only - All Inclusive
description:
Hotel Riu Montego Bay is perfect for an unforgettable holiday in paradise. From its location on a white sand beach, this adults-only all-inclusive hotel has the ideal facilities: several pools, the Splash Water World water park, a wide range of dining options and endless entertainment choices.
This 24-hour all-inclusive hotel in Montego Bay has more than 800 rooms, which offer you all the amenities to make your stay a unique experience, including minibars, drink dispensers, air conditioning, ceiling fans and many more services. If you visit one of the 5 pools, you can enjoy perfect moments of relaxation thanks to the water loungers and the sun deck. But if you’re someone who prefers the sea, you can use the private area for guests on the beach.
This adults-only hotel provides top dining so that you can taste our chefs’ exquisite creations during your holiday: from incredible American buffet breakfasts with live cooking stations, to the best Italian and Asian dishes. And you mustn’t forget to try the authentic Jamaican barbecue which we’ll prepare for you in the beach area. What’s more, there are several bars where you can have an aperitif at any time of day.
It wouldn’t be a RIU holiday without entertainment. So, you can choose from the Splash Water World water park, the daytime activity programmes such as RiuFit, live shows in the evenings, parties in the discotheque, sports including diving and kayak near the hotel or doing your favourite exercise routines at the gym. But if you prefer the chance to unwind, we suggest you head to the Renova Spa and book a massage, beauty service or the treatment you fancy the most. We guarantee you will return from your holiday totally refreshed.
If you want to make the most of your holiday in Jamaica to enjoy tourism, we recommend excursion to the north of the island, the SumFest reggae parties in Montego Bay, Glistening Bay where plankton lights up under the water at night, or the Cockpit Country area. For more information, check our tourist guide to Montego Bay and you can explore the surroundings of Hotel Riu Montego Bay in more detail.

You'll get to taste the finest international, Japanese, and Italian cuisine, or try the best Jamaican barbecue beside the beach. With nearly 600 rooms distributed throughout four buildings, each space is designed to offer the utmost comfort and luxury. The Hotel RiuNegril has a conference room to hold your meetings and events in Jamaica. This room is fully equipped to make your event, corporate or social, a complete success. In addition, we offer all the services and facilities offered by RIU Hotels & Resorts to meet all your needs.

name: Iberostar Selection Rose Hall Suites All Inclusive
description:
This 5-star hotel is located on Montego Bay, in a beachfront complex along with 2 other hotels. Iberostar Selection Rose Hall Suites is an All Inclusive hotel where you can experience Jamaica’s natural paradise right on the beachfront. While you’re getting your scuba diving certification, the little ones will have a blast playing at the waterpark Aquafun, floating in the lazy river, or enjoying the awesome Star Camp activities. Treat yourself to a hydrotherapy circuit at one of the best spas in the Caribbean. And, last but not least, feast yourself on Jamaican cuisine at one of the hotel’s 5 restaurants!
Did you know that the British author, Ian Fleming, was in Jamaica when he created the super-famous secret agent, James Bond? And that the island was where North American actor, Errol Flynn, spent the happiest years of his life? You’ll find out why when you stay at the Iberostar Selection Rose Hall Suites.

name: Sandals Royal Plantation
description: The club resort is just five minutes by car from the tourist as well as town centre of Ocho Rios. Sangster International Airport is 110 km away, whilst it is 115 km to Norman Manley airport. The town of Montego Bay is approximately 90 minutes away by car. The luxurious hotel comprises a total of 74 suites as well as a terrace and a garden. Facilities include a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, a safe and a currency exchange bureau. Further facilities at this air-conditioned beach hotel include a bar, a hairdressing salon, two top-notch gourmet restaurants as well as conference facilities. It is also possible to make use of the 24-hour room service and laundry services. There is a car park for those arriving by car. The luxurious suites each come with tea and coffee making facilities, ironing equipment, an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer and a bathrobe. Each of the suites also comes with a direct dial telephone, cable TV with a video recorder, a radio, Internet access, an electronic hire safe, a CD player and a double or king-sized bed. The air conditioning is individually controlled. Guests will also find a living area and telephones in the bedrooms. A 24-hour caretaker and the daily New York Times fax service are also on offer here. Guests may also enjoy the private balconies with spectacular views over the ocean. In the outdoor complex is a swimming pool, a poolside snack bar, sun loungers and parasols laid out ready for use. Leisure options include a hot tub, a sauna, a solarium, a gym as well as a massage service and spa options. Further sporting options include water aerobics, diving, windsurfing, sailing, canoeing, aerobics and pedalo hire. Sports enthusiasts may also enjoy tennis, golf, billiards and beach volleyball. Entertainment events also occasionally take place. Airport transfers are included for both Sandals and Beaches resorts, Online check in required to get access. description: Sitting right on the beach, on one of the most fantastic islands in the world - Jamaica, this Victorian style hotel is the place for the perfect holiday. Anyone who has dreamt of waking up to the breath-taking views of the Caribbean will be at the right place in this adults-only property. After a good night's sleep in the cosy and elegant rooms, they can head to the clubhouse for a nutritious breakfast complete with pastries, jams, butter and anything they can imagine. Then the lake-style pool is the place where they can enjoy a relaxed swim or tan surrounded by spacious tropical gardens. The underwater stools around the bar are the places where to sit comfortably while drinking a nice cold cocktail and contemplating what a treatment to get in the spa centre. When the evening comes guests can head to the beach for a romantic walk or to any of the 5 restaurants for a delicious dinner.

This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. . Make yourself at home in one of the 407 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Rooms have private balconies or patios. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. . This hotel is all inclusive. name: Half Moon
description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can get some exercise with a round of golf or enjoy a lazy day at the private beach. This Colonial resort also features concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and an arcade/game room. Getting to the surf and sand is a breeze with the complimentary beach shuttle. Grab a bite to eat at one of the resort's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at the beach bar, the poolside bar, or one of 4 bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Event facilities at this resort consist of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available on request), and limited parking is available onsite.

name: Round Hill Hotel & Villas
description: Steeped in rich history and understated luxury, Round Hill welcomes you with genuine Jamaican hospitality. Located just west of Montego Bay, a 20-minute drive from Sangster International Airport (MBJ), this iconic resort comprises 27 individually owned villas and 36 oceanfront rooms nestled within 110 acres of lush tropical gardens. Overlooking the Caribbean Sea and a double infinity-edge pool, the oceanfront rooms offer either spacious vaulted ceilings and large louvered windows on the upper level or spacious patios and balconies on the lower level. Villas feature two to six-bedroom suites, living rooms, verandas, and magnificent views, with 23 boasting private pools. Each villa bedroom includes an ensuite bathroom and terrace. Guests can book an entire villa with a private pool and dedicated staff or individual villa suites. A surcharge applies for in-villa breakfast prepared and served daily. Resort amenities include a private beach, Pineapple Kids Club, 7UP Club Spa, fitness center, two restaurants showcasing farm-to-table cuisine sourced from local farms and the resort's organic garden, three bars, and a variety of motorized and non-motorized watersports.

A sanctuary where every detail is meticulously crafted to elevate relaxation and ignite your senses. Princess Senses the Mangrove offers a modern interpretation of luxury, with an array of options including ultra-luxury at the Platinum Club and chic-sophistication at the O-Club. Our resort exudes refinement and relaxation, weaving together sophistication with contemporary finishes to create an atmosphere that resonates with your senses. Indulge in an experience where your every desire is effortlessly catered to, and each moment is filled with pure delight. As our esteemed guest, you'll have the freedom to explore even further.

name: Beaches Negril Resort & Spa by Sandals
description: Right by the stunning, 11-kilometre long white sandy beach of Long Bay in Negril, this complex is a spacious combination of lush wooded landscape, fine sand and verdant gardens. The private beach, accessible exclusively to guests of the hotel is 400-metre long and offers sweeping views over the Caribbean Sea. Designed by the architect Evan Williams with all visitors in mind, be they singles, couples, families with children, and persons with reduced mobility, the property blends traditional Caribbean architecture with contemporary features to ensure a carefree and memorable stay to its patrons. Airport transfers are included for both Sandals and Beaches resorts, Online check in required to get access. Sandals and Beaches resorts will honor the customer loyalty points.

name: Sunset at the Palms Rsrt-Adults Only-All Inclusive
description: Nestled within 40, 000 m² of lush gardens and just steps from Negril's stunning white sandy beach, this charming hotel offers a central location close to local attractions. Rick's Café is 11. 5 km away, Times Square shopping is 7 km away, and the craft market is 8. 5 km away. The hotel features air-conditioned rooms with elegant bathrooms, a bar, a hairdressing salon, and conference facilities. Rooms boast cable TV, internet access, and distinct Balinese-style decor, including dark wood furnishings, linen curtains, and king-size beds. Guests can enjoy garden views from their balconies, furnished with comfortable loungers and teakwood tables. For a seamless arrival, consider 'Club MoBay VIP Airport Arrival Service' which offers expedited immigration and customs processing, lounge access, and refreshments.

name: Deja Resort All Inclusive
description: Located in the heart of Montego Bay's ‘Hip Strip' this 93 room All-Inclusive resort will submerge you in Jamaica's rich culture. Just 5 Minutes from the Sangster's International Airport this unique resort is surrounded by a wide range of shops, restaurants, nightclubs and the world famous Doctor's Cave Beach. Deja's central location provides easy access to island wide tours and attractions which can be easily arranged through our tour desk.Retreat from your activity filled day to one of our comfortable, contemporary rooms. Enjoy thoughtfully chosen amenities designed with your needs in mind. Every Deja Resort room includes; USB compatible flat screen cable television, air conditioning, in-room safe, iron and ironing board, complimentary WIFI, hair dryer and kettle. Let us help you find the perfect accommodation to suit your needs:

name: Coco La Palm Seaside Resort
description: Located on Negril's famous 11 km sandy beach, nightlife and shopping opportunities can be found in the vicinity of this charming property. The centre of Negril is a 20-minute walk away and Negril Airport is about 82 km from the accommodation. This beach hotel offers locally inspired architecture and lush gardens. It comprises 75 rooms and features air conditioning, a bar and a restaurant which serves a selection of dishes influenced by the flavours and tastes of Jamaica. Guests can take advantage of the 2 outdoor pools with parasols, and those who wish to relax can do so in the hot tub and with a professional massage treatment.

name: Merrils Beach Resort 2
description: A room with a view of the ocean, individually adjustable air conditioning, and a first-class restaurant that serves fresh and delicious local dishes – what more can one want from a vacation in Jamaica? This beachfront hotel on the north-west coast of the island offers even more. A 5-minute drive from the centre of Negril, with a private parking for those arriving by car, it combines traditional Caribbean hospitality with excellent amenities and services, like laundry, free Internet connection and currency exchange. After they wake up to the sound of birds singing outside their window, guests can take an exhilarating dip in the swimming pool surrounded by a real botanical garden, and in the evening, delight in the warm breeze on the private balcony.

room_types.name: Double or Twin SUPERIOR GARDEN VIEW
room_types.description: Double or Twin SUPERIOR GARDEN VIEW

name: Country Country
description: Hand-crafted cottages await you along Negril's famed Seven Mile Beach. Immerse yourself in a jungle-beach paradise with the convenience of room service. Within our thoughtfully designed village, you'll find little wanting. And if a desire does arise, a stroll along the beach will capture the authentic Jamaican vibe. Negril Beach is legendary, attracting intrepid tourists since the 1960s when it was a small fishing village. Negril's beach culture has deep roots, and each distinct environment boasts a unique identity steeped in history.

name: Jakes
description: Jakes Hotel, nestled in the secluded fishing village of Treasure Beach, St. Elizabeth, Jamaica, offers a unique bohemian escape. Located 57 miles west of Montego Bay's Sangster International Airport (MBJ), guests can relax in stylish, original 'chic shacks' or explore a variety of activities. Savor authentic Jamaican cuisine at Jack Sprat, a popular restaurant among locals and visitors, or indulge in herbal steam baths. Explore nearby YS Falls, enjoy mountain biking and river tours, or marvel at the gentle manatees. No trip is complete without a visit to the iconic Pelican Bar, often hailed as the Caribbean's coolest. Guests can also enjoy a world music library, a yoga and meditation room, and complimentary internet access.

name: Jamaica Inn
description: Situated on a pristine, crescent-shaped beach in Ocho Rios, Jamaica Inn offers breathtaking views of the Caribbean Sea. Just two miles from the town center, this elegant resort has been a top vacation destination since 1950. Its 52 suites are spread across eight acres, each boasting sweeping ocean vistas. The 700-foot private beach is considered one of the best in the region. Guests can enjoy a variety of activities, including croquet, swimming, snorkeling, kayaking, sunfish sailing, and paddleboarding. Diving facilities are available nearby. The Ocean Spa, perched on a bluff overlooking the sea, offers relaxing treatments in idyllic outdoor rooms accompanied by the soothing sounds of the waves.

name: Samsara Cliff Resort & Spa
description: The boutique resort is an oceanfront hotel located on the cliffs of Negril commanding spectacular sea views. It offers a casual and intimate atmosphere with friendly staff who make all guests feel welcome and at home. Guests are greeted in a lobby with reception and check-out service. The hotel has a total of 50 rooms. Facilities include a hotel safe and currency exchange facilities. The establishment also has its own sea view bar and restaurant. Guests arriving by car may park their vehicles in the hotel car park. Room types range from traditional hotel rooms to tropical cottages and unique pillar houses. Each room is air-conditioned with free wifi, flat screen 40' cable TV and direct dial telephone. The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool and splash pool. Sun loungers are provided for guests to relax on the spacious seaside terrace directly on the cliffs with easy access to swimming, snorkeling, and scuba diving nearby. Breakfast, lunch and dinner are served in the oceanfront restaurant or al fresco in the evening with fantastic views of the Caribbean. Guest have exchange privileges at the sister hotel Legends Beach Resort via Free hotel shuttle twice daily.

name: Legends Beach Resort
description: Boasting a stunning beach front restaurant and bar, this boutique hotel is located on Negril's famous 11-kilometre white sand beach, within walking distance of the Negril Craft Market, Duty Free shopping, as well as water sports and local entertainment. Casual and carefree, this intimate hotel combines contemporary features, convenient amenities and friendly, personalised service that is sure to meet the hospitality requirements of even the most demanding globetrotters. Guests can start the day with a light breakfast and an exhilarating dip in the outdoor swimming pool, while some of the popular activities available include water-skiing, diving and windsurfing. Guests also enjoy exchange privileges at sister hotel Samsara Cliff Resort via Free hotel shuttle operating twice daily making Legends a popular beach hotel in Negril offering excellent value for money.

name: Negril Palms
description: Situated along the beautiful 11 km Negril strip, this hotel is near an array of shopping venues, restaurants, nightlife opportunities and the beach. Links to public transport can be found 3 km away and Sangster International Airport is about 40 km from the property. This resort is a unique concept in boutique hotel design where relaxation, fine dining, art, quality entertainment and wellness come together to create the ultimate experience in rejuvenation. It has 34 rooms in total and facilities include air conditioning, a café, a TV room and a restaurant. All rooms are equipped with cedar wood furnishings, a flat-screen TV with satellite/cable channels, and individually adjustable air conditioning.

name: Grand Lido Negril All-Inclusive - Adults Only
description: Jamaica, the birthplace of reggae and home to stunning Caribbean beaches, is ideal for sun-seekers and culture enthusiasts. Along its coast, a range of resorts caters to all ages and travel styles. Grand Lido, a private oceanfront boutique hotel in Negril, offers a unique, all-inclusive, clothing-optional experience for adults over 21. With 26 exquisite ocean-facing suites in a secluded enclave, guests enjoy pristine ocean views, premium butler service, and access to two nearby luxury resorts: Royalton Negril and the adults-only Hideaway at Royalton Negril.

name: The Signature Level Grand Palladium Lady Hamilton
description: The luxurious The Signature Level at Grand Palladium Lady Hamilton Resort & Spa enjoys a fantastic oceanfront location right on the wonderful white sandy beach and with views of the turquoise waters of the Caribbean Sea. The hotel with its elegant architecture features the largest pool in Jamaica, 10 restaurants, 13 bars, an excellent spa and wellness centre as well as sports facilities. The airport of Montego Bay can be reached within about 40 minutes.
